reason: P06-02 adds a repo-root-only synthetic two-firm plus separate operator initializer with immutable local image IDs, unique secrets, per-firm networks/volumes/keys, guarded resource ownership, read-only repeat verification and fail-closed config/target collisions. Apply-LocalMigration and the fixture share identical extracted app-user SQL; SubscriptionLedgerTests and SubscriptionOperatorTests cover its ledger/authorization callers with real PostgreSQL. The scoped Docker acceptance exercises first/repeat setup, all-table/MFA/key preservation, TLS, occupied ports, foreign volume, wrong cwd/config/tampered file and stopped-target rejection. No runtime application/API/UI/schema change; no main8080 rebuild/restart locally.
